params.1266: It's a Trap! No, Wait, It's a Pie

params.1274: You must perform each of the following steps to complete this Task:
params.1275: Fish for the tuna and salmon.
params.1277: Create pastry dough and make it into a pie shell.
params.1279: Bake the pie in the oven.
params.1292: This Elite Task is part of the Seers' Village set.
